thread:
maria: Quick sync — final checklist for the Marketplace announce tomorrow. Need owners on press embargo, blog publish, landing cutover, SI oncall, and translations. I'm going to run hourly preflight checks starting 09:00 PT. Who can own each item?

aj: I can take press embargo coordination. Confirming embargo window and approved quote list. Any embargo shifts?

maria: @aj thanks — embargo stays 09:30 PT. Legal already signed the quote pack but we need to confirm partner logos for the release note. @legal-bot did the asset greenlight go through?

legal-bot: Asset review complete. Two partner logos flagged (CloudWave, EdgeStack) — need updated SVGs (transparent bg). Owner: @kevin.

kevin: I have EdgeStack SVG in the assets bucket. CloudWave asked for 2 hours to provide corrected file. I'll follow up.

rachel-marketing: I'll own the blog publish flow. Plan: schedule blog post at 09:35 PT, social out at 09:40 PT. Need final hero image and a short partner quote for the top paragraph.

sasha: Landing page cutover is on me. Quick recap of steps I'll run at cutover:
```
1) Swap feature-flag on `marketplace_live`
2) Promote staging index -> prod (invalidate CDN)
3) Run smoke script: `curl -f https://redwood.ai/marketplace/health`
4) Push final analytics tag
```
I'll do a dry-run tonight at 20:00 PT. @deploy-bot can you schedule the smoke test?

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 7123420000 (20:00 PT). Will post results in this thread.

maria: Perfect. Also need SI oncall roster for the first 6 hours after launch. @aj can you confirm SI coverage and contact list? Put PagerDuty rotation for any integration failures.

aj: Confirmed. SI leads on rotation: Priya, Marco, Jun. I'll dump the oncall contacts into the launch sheet and ping their Slack DMs 30 mins before cutover.

kevin: Re: translations — localization team says Spanish/DE/FR ready, APAC (ja/ko/zh) will be staged as `partial` and linked to a banner 'coming soon'. Should we ship partial localized landing or fall back to EN?

rachel-marketing: Recommendation: ship EN hero + localized body for EU/NA markets. APAC banner is fine for now, call it out in the blog. We can follow up with a micro-update for APAC 48h after launch.

sasha: From infra: we have a soft SLA on listing creation during first 2 hours (5s p95). If we see degradation, default fallback is to route to the lightweight listing API (no thumbnails) to keep latency under control. Ops will flip route if p95 > 7s.

maria: Nice — can you add that fallback to the runbook snippet? Put exact commands.

sasha: Adding now:
```
# Fallback route
kubectl set env deployment/marketplace-router FALLBACK_MODE=lightweight --namespace=prod
# Validate
curl -sS https://redwood.ai/marketplace/listing?id=test | jq '.status'
```

kevin: Noting dependencies: partner tenant provisioning must complete by 08:30 PT or we delay listing sync. @aj make sure tenant provisioning hits that SLA.

aj: On it — I moved tenant provisioning to high priority and notified the ops eng squad.

maria: Final ask: anyone who needs to update the press kit or blog copy, drop edits by 22:00 PT tonight. After that we'll only do emergency tweaks. I'll run the first hourly preflight at 09:00 PT and post status. :rocket:

kevin: A couple of quick checks I'll run tonight: verify partner logo rendering across 320/768/1440 and check microcopy truncation on mobile. Will report back.

rachel-marketing: I'll stage a pinned tweet template and the partner quote card in the social folder. Tagging @kevin for final logo.

deploy-bot: Dry-run smoke test completed at 7123420000 — all `200` except one 503 on `/marketplace/thumbnail` (retried and passed). See logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/job/7123420000

maria: Great catch — that 503 might be transient. @sasha please confirm thumbnail service health in the morning.

sasha: Will monitor. If we see recurring 5xxs during the first hour after live, ops will trigger the thumbnail circuit-breaker and serve placeholder images.

maria: Thanks team — posting this as the canonical thread for the announce runbook. I'll update the sheet as we confirm items. Ping here for any late blockers. :wave:
